title: Implement the secured M3 Companion Workbench
goal: Render exact Host setup protection handoff and lifecycle previews through the existing loopback Companion.
acceptanceCriteria: The embedded Workbench renders Setup protection Profile Plan Module and lifecycle projections without computing authority in browser code.
Every new route enforces session Host Origin CSRF request-size stale-preview and cancellation behavior before Host execution.
Preview confirmation returns a local receipt with exact Host result identity and no apply side effect.
Positive and negative tests prove exact Host identity PackageRoot and TargetRoot immutability and absence of path command or remote gateways.
risks: A browser route could bypass Host authority or accept a stale preview.
decisions: Use one typed Host operation endpoint plus hash confirmation receipts and no apply route.
